text:
As energy is transferred into different forms, it eventually becomes dissipated.
What does this mean?
A
All the energy disappears.
B
The energy finally changes into every possible form of energy.
C
The energy spreads out among the objects and their surroundings.
D
The total amount of energy becomes less.

options.label: B
options.text: The energy finally changes into every possible form of energy.

options.label: C
options.text: The energy spreads out among the objects and their surroundings.

options.label: D
options.text: The total amount of energy becomes less.
